answer: Work waits on the lantern until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the velvet of the next round. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the terrace of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. The design leans on time-locked work history, revoked by a single upheld challenge, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
